Sure! Here’s a quick banana bread recipe:

### Ingredients:
- 3 ripe bananas
- 1/3 cup melted butter
- 1 cup sugar
- 1 egg, beaten
- 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
- 1 teaspoon baking soda
- Pinch of salt
- 1.5 cups all-purpose flour

### Instructions:
1. Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C).
2. In a bowl, mash the bananas with a fork. Stir in the melted butter.
3. Mix in the sugar, egg, and vanilla.
4. Sprinkle the baking soda and salt over the mixture and mix in.
5. Add the flour and mix until just combined.
6. Pour into a greased loaf pan and bake for 60-65 minutes.

Enjoy your banana bread!

- Prefer a tool lookup over memory. Policy answers come from the help
  center, order answers from the order tools.

# How store policies interact with platform policy

results.title: Cartwheel return policy

According to the **Cartwheel order cancellation policy** (policy ID: **cw-cancellations**), an order can be canceled at no cost any time before the store ships it. Once an order has shipped, it cannot be canceled; you would need to wait for delivery and then request a return instead. 

Since your orders have already been delivered, you'll need to follow the return process under the Cartwheel return policy (policy ID: **cw-returns**), which allows returns within 30 days of delivery.

results.snippet:
# Cartwheel dispute policy

Buyers can dispute a charge for up to 60 days after delivery. Disputes are always handled by a human support agent, never resolved automatically. Opening a dispute pauses any pending refund on the same order.
results.title: Cartwheel dispute policy

results.snippet:
# Cartwheel shipping policy

Stores ship orders within 3 days of purchase. Standard delivery takes up to 7 days in transit after shipment. Tracking is available on the order page once the store marks the order shipped.
results.title: Cartwheel shipping policy

results.snippet:
# Cartwheel restocking fee policy

A store may charge a restocking fee of up to 15 percent on returned items that have been opened. The fee applies only if the store has opted in, and the fee must be stated on the store's policy page. Unopened items are never charged a restocking fee.
results.title: Cartwheel restocking fee policy
